faq.q1: How do I enter cheats on GTA SA Android?
faq.a1: During gameplay, tap the screen to bring up the keyboard and type the cheat code exactly as shown. Some codes require a short pause between characters.
faq.a2: Using cheats may prevent you from earning certain achievements and can affect your save file. Use a backup save before experimenting.
